title: 1st Academy Awards (1929) — Best Picture: Wings (1927)
t: 1st Academy Awards (1929) — Best Picture: Wings (1927)
description:
1st Academy Awards — held May 16, 1929 at Hollywood Roosevelt Hotel, Los Angeles. Hosted by Douglas Fairbanks (Academy president).

The top honor, Best Picture, went to Wings (1927). William A. Wellman's World War I aviation epic; the only silent film ever to win Best Picture.

Tickets cost $5; the ceremony lasted 15 minutes and winners had been announced three months earlier.
